newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BOSMAN MATCH TO BE HELD IN SPAIN ON SUNDAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOSMAN MATCH TO BE HELD IN SPAIN ON SUNDAY.

text.p: The International Soccer Players' Union (AIFP) said on Tuesday a benefit match long promised to Belgian Jean-Marc Bosman would take place on Sunday in Barcelona.
AIFP said in a statement the match, which has been repeatedly blocked by several soccer authorities in the past year, would be played on April 27 in Barcelona's Olympic stadium.
Last month the Spanish Football Association vetoed the benefit match being staged in Spain. Earlier plans to have it organised in Paris, where the AIFP is based, were also opposed and abandoned.
The benefit match hit another snag last week when the Belgian soccer union said it would oppose the game which AIFP secretary-general Didier Roustan hoped to stage in Brussels.
Bosman's case in the European Court of Justice brought an end to transfer fees for out-of-contract EU players but left Bosman himself financially stranded after a five-year legal fight.

The match will be played between a European side and a team from the rest of the world. Top players like Manchester United's Frenchman Eric Cantona and Bulgarian Hristo Stoichkov will play for Europe while Diego Maradona will lead the other team.
